description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin named 'enterkey' that handles custom behavior for Enter and Shift+Enter key presses within the editor, including managing block splitting, inserting line breaks, and handling list items.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.plugins.enterkey
classes.description: Object containing methods for handling Enter and Shift+Enter key behavior in CKEditor.

methods.name: enterBlock
methods.description: Handles the behavior when Enter is pressed in block mode, splitting blocks, managing list items, and inserting new blocks.

methods.name: enterBr
methods.description: Handles the behavior when Enter is pressed in inline mode, inserting line breaks or new blocks depending on context.

methods.name: shiftEnter
methods.description: Handles Shift+Enter key press, enforcing block mode or inserting line breaks within preformatted text.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Main function to handle Enter key press, deciding between block or line break behavior based on configuration.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Utility function to retrieve the current selection range from the editor.
